title: Simple & Multi‑Step Rates
subject: Mathematics
description: This worksheet focuses on multi‑step rate problems.

questions.question: A tank already has 15 litres of water. A tap fills it at a rate of 3 litres per minute. How much water is in the tank after 20 minutes?
A car travels 180 km in 3 hours. How far does it travel in 4.5 hours?
A school bus picks up 8 children per stop. After 9 stops, 5 children get off. How many children are left on the bus?
questions.explanation: Picked up = 8 × 9 = 72. Left on bus = 72 − 5 = 67 children.

questions.question: A worker earns $144 for 9 hours of work. How much does he earn for 15 hours?
A shop sells 5 pens for $6. How much do 8 pens cost?
A train travels 350 km in 5 hours. How long does it take to travel 490 km at the same speed?
A printer prints 24 pages per minute. It printed for 4 minutes, stopped, then printed for another 3 minutes. How many pages did it print in total?
questions.explanation: First batch = 24 × 4 = 96. Second batch = 24 × 3 = 72. Total = 96 + 72 = 168 pages.

questions.question: A tank had 50 litres of water. A tap was turned on and after 8 minutes, the tank had 90 litres. What is the rate of water flow per minute?
A cyclist rides at a speed of 15 km/h for 2 hours, then at 10 km/h for 3 hours. How far does he travel in total?
questions.explanation: First leg = 15 × 2 = 30 km. Second leg = 10 × 3 = 30 km. Total = 30 + 30 = 60 km.

questions.question: A worker packs 8 boxes per hour for the first 4 hours, then 6 boxes per hour for the next 3 hours. How many boxes does he pack in total?
questions.explanation: First shift = 8 × 4 = 32. Second shift = 6 × 3 = 18. Total = 32 + 18 = 50 boxes.

questions.question: A swimming pool has 120 litres of water. It is filled at 25 litres per minute for 4 minutes. How much water is in the pool now?
A bus travels 250 km in 4 hours. How far does it travel in 7.2 hours?
A machine produces 360 toys in 6 hours. How many hours does it take to produce 480 toys?
A tap fills a tank at 4 litres per minute. The tank had 10 litres and after some time it had 58 litres. How long did the tap run?
A student reads 12 pages per hour for 3 hours, then 8 pages per hour for 4 hours. How many pages does he read in total?
A car travels 320 km in 4 hours. How long does it take to travel 560 km?
A typist types 30 words per minute for 5 minutes, then 40 words per minute for 4 minutes. How many words does she type in total?
A school canteen sells 25 bowls of noodles per hour. How many bowls will they sell in 4 hours and 30 minutes?
A worker earns $120 for 8 hours. How much does he earn for 13 hours?
A pool loses 2 litres of water per hour through evaporation. It initially had 100 litres. How much water is left after 14 hours?
